messages:
maria (acct-exec): Quick sync — Cust: BrightApps. They want a 4-week POC to validate smart summarization. Need success criteria, perf targets, and a ballpark cost. High-level asks:
- 10k users/day, peak 200 TPS for inference, avg 20 tokens/gen, 4M tokens/day estimate
- Security questionnaire answered (SAML, KMS)
- Can we hit p95 latency < 250ms on hosted dedicated?

liam (sales-engineer): Thanks. A few clarifying q's: is 200 TPS sustained or bursty? what's SLA during demo hours? Also do they require private VPC for PII?

maria (acct-exec): Mostly bursty — 2h daily peak windows. SLA not strict for POC, but they'd like production-like perf during peak. They will provide anonymized prompt set (≈1k examples).

jordan (solutions-eng): Rough capacity calc: if avg gen 20 tokens and 200 TPS => 4000 tokens/sec => 345M tokens/day at continuous, but with 2h daily peak it's 28.8M tokens during peak window. Your 4M/day estimate aligns if overall traffic is lower. Recommend planning for peak headroom x1.5.

jordan (solutions-eng): GPU sizing suggestion: 1x A100 80GB can handle ~300-400 tokens/sec for the model family they picked (redwood-medium). For 200 TPS we'd need 1-2 GPUs and autoscale to 3 for headroom. If we use quantized variant, can fit 2x on 80GB and push throughput.

liam (sales-engineer): Cost sketch for hosted Dedicated POC (1 month):
```
Base dedicated + 2 GPUs reserved: $12k/mo
Autoscale bursts & storage: ~$3k/mo
Estimate consumed tokens (4M) @ $0.0001/token = $400
Total ~ $15.4k (one-off POC)
``` 
(we can refine after we see the prompt evals)

olivia (customer-success): I'll own onboarding and eval harness. Need the prompt set by EOD Thur. Also flagging security Qs: they want SAML, KMS, and SOC2 attestation. SEs: can we supply sample KMS integration docs?

jordan (solutions-eng): Yes — we have a KMS integration guide. POC plan deliverables: runbook, perf script (wrk-like), eval harness with 1k prompts, rollback policy. I'll drop the runbook snippet here later.

deploy-bot: Capacity check complete — baseline perf test on staging: p95 latency 210ms @ 150 TPS on 1x A100-80GB quantized model. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/179350

maria (acct-exec): Great. Next steps:
- @olivia confirm prompt set arrival
- @jordan produce runbook + model variant matrix by Wed
- @liam update commercial sketch with a low-tier option (1 GPU) and high-tier (3 GPUs)
- I'll send the security packet to BrightApps

liam (sales-engineer): I'll prepare two SKU options and a short note on expected token overspend. 

jordan (solutions-eng): Runbook draft ETA tomorrow. Also propose acceptance criteria:
- Qualitative: summaries >= 80% accuracy on eval set
- Quantitative: p95 latency <= 300ms during peak, error rate < 1%

maria (acct-exec): Perfect. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff w/ BrightApps for Fri 10am PT.

olivia (customer-success): Added to calendar. :calendar:

maria (acct-exec): Thanks team. Closing loop after runbook and SKUs. :thumbsup:
